c.title: $4,000 / 4br - 1200ft2 - Kitsilano 4 Bedroom Apartment (Kitsilano, Westside, Vancouver, UBC)
c.description:
-Recently updated kitchen, includes two family size fridges, range with a self-cleaning oven and dishwasher
-4 Bedrooms and 2 Bathrooms
-Bus stops to UBC and downtown are very close to the property
-The apartment is on the ground floor of the triplex, there are two other units in the building
-Two private entrances for the suite; one on the Northside and the other on the Eastside of the building
-Ensuite laundry
-Tile floor throughout suite for easy maintenance
-Private patio is adjacent to living room, living room is open to the kitchen
-The suite is bright and has all double glazed windows - very quiet
-Hot water is supplied by a tankless system so it is readily available
-Outlets for cable and internet
-Separate area is provided for bike storage and a locker
-NO SMOKING and NO PET POLICY is FIRM
-The suite is well suited for 4 serious students or young professionals
-Four people maximum for the suite
-Not furnished
-Utilities are in addition to the rent
-Deposit of 1/2 of the rent is required to secure the suite
-In your e-mail please provide a description about yourself and roommates. I.e. if you are students, where and what are you studying (ex. UBC English and Math majors or if you work, what are your occupations (ex. Nurse, Waiter, Lifeguard, Accountant, Trades ) etc.
-No Subletting
